text_block_list.text: Short while after coming to Tracen Academy. One day, looking for Uma Musume to train with—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *Chomp!*
Uma Musume bit me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Kuku... Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha! Look at that face, look at that face~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha-? Don't know who Windy-chan is...?! Pretty insolent, huh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Standing before you is Evil Genius, King of Darkness, Demon Lord of this world! Shinko Windy-chan, that's me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ni-shi-shi-shi! Better remember this!
Ever since that day... things like jack-in-the-box prank—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Puhuhu.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uhyahyahyahya-!
And pitfall traps—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe...! Gyahahahaha-!
For some reason, Shinko Windy pranked me constantly.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ni-shi-shi-! Fell for it, fell for it! That cream puff loaded with wasabi!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Awesome, right? Shaking in boots, right? Blown away, right? Windy-chan supreme, right?! Wahaha-!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what wrong? Why crying?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hurts? ...Hmph, no choice! Drink this. Regular water, not fizzy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Don't get wrong idea! ...Villains always toy with prey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Once recovered... *Gao!* Shi-shi-shi, that how Windy-chan operates evil schemes!
One day, went to watch mock races and spotted Shinko Windy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —...Haa, haa, haa, haa...!
No trace of prankster vibe. Sharp gaze fixed ahead, tearing through dirt in dead earnest.
Charging forward covered in mud without flinching. Felt like victory within grasp—
...However.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Final straightaway! Shinko Windy presses attack! Battling for lead... 200m remaining!
Hit final stretch, but instead of looking ahead... kept glancing side to side.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa, haa, haa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (...Tch, dammit! Right in front, but can't pass her!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Last time, time before that, time before that too! Someone always in way— ...dammit! Footsteps, cheers, all annoying!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Crowd not even looking here! Annoying, irritating, can't catch up, at this rate—)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Grrrrrr~! Don't want this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —*Chomp!*

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Sh-Shinko Windy?! Is Shinko Windy interfering?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Huu, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: After deliberation: finishing order stands. Shinko Windy issued strict warning.
—Finished 2nd place. Uma Musume who got bitten accelerated on final stretch, taking 1st by neck.
Interference unacceptable. Yet desperation to win painfully obvious.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Y-You're—
Called out to her, but words failed—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *Chomp!*
No idea why sudden attack... Stood staring blankly at Shinko Windy for few seconds—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, hehehehe...! ...Looking, looking right at me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wahahahaha-! Looking right at me-!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bleh! Never catch me!
Shinko Windy dashed off in high spirits. Ended up chasing after her for now.
Running with big grin... Looked like having genuine fun.
